text.aria-label: Title text 'Wind farms W1 to W3, ensemble weather, 12 to 252 hours: with their own history the pooled networks match experiment 313's network from day 3 and trail it at days 1 to 2. Dot: estimate. Line: 98.75% interval from resampling whole months. Zero: same as experiment 313; below zero is better.'
text.tspan: Wind farms W1 to W3, ensemble weather, 12 to 252 hours: with their own history
the pooled networks match experiment 313's network from day 3 and trail it at
days 1 to 2. Dot: estimate. Line: 98.75% interval from resampling whole
months. Zero: same as experiment 313; below zero is better.
